prompt:
The chart below shows how much grain, fruit and vegetables were produced in four farming areas of one country in 2023.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Production of grain, fruit and vegetables in four farming areas, 2023
visual.alt: Grouped bar chart comparing the production of grain, fruit and vegetables in four farming areas, in thousands of tonnes.

key_points: Grain is by far the largest of the three products: 1,480 thousand tonnes across the four regions, more than half of total production (out of 2,810 thousand tonnes)

The single highest value is South Plain's grain output (640 thousand tonnes); this region ranks first overall (860 thousand tonnes) and is also the most one-sided region — about three-quarters of its output is grain
Rivermouth is the only region where fruit leads (310 thousand tonnes) and on its own accounts for exactly half of the four regions' total fruit production

Highmoor is lowest or close to lowest in all three products; with a total of 450 thousand tonnes it is the smallest region, but it also has the most evenly balanced split across the three products (180 / 150 / 120)
Eastvale is grain-heavy (420 thousand tonnes) but weak in fruit (90 thousand tonnes); South Plain produces the least fruit of all (70 thousand tonnes)
The differences between products also show up in the scale of the range: grain has a very wide spread between regions (180-640), while vegetables have a narrow one (120-280)
common_mistakes: Reading through all twelve bars one by one instead of giving the two main patterns (grain's dominance, Rivermouth standing out in fruit)
Forgetting to compare regions by product and instead listing each region in a separate paragraph
Dropping the thousand-tonnes unit ('Eastvale produced 420 grain')
Adding opinion or recommendation ('Highmoor needs to increase its output')
Never calculating totals and so not stating which region produces the most
